overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted and professional social media presence across academic and professional platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon), totaling 3,580 followers. His content is highly focused on computational social science, disinformation, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and research team updates. While LinkedIn provides the highest volume of total engagements due to a larger follower base, Bluesky shows the highest overall engagement rate, demonstrating a highly active and receptive audience for academic and research-oriented content.

contentThemes.description: Updates on tools (like CooRnet v2.0), publications, and methodology discussions regarding coordinated link sharing and disinformation campaigns.
Announcements regarding open postdoc positions and PhD opportunities within his research team.
Celebrating team accomplishments such as newly awarded research grants and upcoming conference presentations.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by posting more frequently on this platform, particularly for interactive content like research inquiries and recruitment.
Utilize rich media, links, or visual assets on LinkedIn to further boost the CTR (Click-Through Rate) on job opportunities and grant announcements where his reach is greatest.
Cross-promote tool updates (such as CooRnet) on LinkedIn to reach a broader industry audience, rather than limiting software releases to Mastodon.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky acts as the most interactive hub, boasting an average engagement rate of 6.14%. It has a highly responsive community particularly interested in new publications and student opportunities, shown by high repost ratios.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a stable, niche academic audience with a solid average engagement rate of 4.55%. It is highly effective for technical tool releases (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn is the primary driver of absolute reach and professional networking. While its average engagement rate is lower (4.87%) due to a larger follower base, it is the most effective platform for high-impact announcements like major grant awards (107 interactions) and postdoctoral hiring.
